main_body: stone brick paving or wall surface
evidence: Repeating flat terrain/wall block pattern covering the entire 4x3 tile area (rows 0-47), matching the terrain kind.

style.evidence: The candidate uses a 5-step warm grey-brown ramp with dark brown-grey mortar lines (dark_material_tone), which is good, and has a few speckle pixels per block. However, every 16x16 tile is an identical copy-pasted repeat, and the interiors of the large bricks (e.g. rows 9-13, 25-29) have large flat fills of a single mid-tone with only 2-3 isolated dots, making the surface look mechanical and noticeably flatter/less dense than the intricate cobblestone paving reference.
